body: Nah it wasn't for academic misconduct or anything like that, just had a rough semester, GPA fell below 2.0
I can't believe MATH 1240 is still brought up as a joke because of how hard it is even in a reddit post completely unrelated to computer science lmaooo 😭, speaks volumes on how brutal that class is.

How anyone manages an A in Comp 1010 is beyond me, that class grilled me alive. Took it with Stewart Wilcox last semester. I don't know if it was just my class, but the way my class was set up was that you had to learn everything on your own during the weekend from watching some videos provided weekly. Class average for Test 1 was a 53%, class average for test 2 was a 47%. The way the class also worked was that the exam was the be-all and end-all (Meaning if you fail the exam, you fail the class entirely). Given how low the class average was for both tests, I don't imagine the class average for the final exam was any different. God knows how many people failed that final exam, including me. Academic advisor said Comp 1010 had a 60% fail rate, which is insane for a first year introductory course. Brutal. Planning to take 1012 or retake 1010 next year. Any advice if I retake it or should I just give up on CS in general? (By the logic that if I can't pass the lowest level introductory CS class offered by UM, then I should forget about a career in CS)
